text.p: Electronics and telecommunications equipment manufacturer ERG Ltd said on Thursday it had formalised its alliance with US-based ADC Telecommunications Inc by signing a manufacturing licence and service agreement.

ERG said under the terms of the agreement, ERG would manufacture and service for ADC the home integrated services unit and other broadband connectivity products for supply to pay TV operator Optus Vision and other prospective customers in the Asia Pacific region.
The home integrated services unit allows subscribers to have access to telephony services alongside pay TV and the Internet.
ERG said fitout of the existing ERG facility in Western Australia had started, along with planning for the recruitment of 90 extra staff to be based at the facility.
Production of the home integrated services unit was expected to commence in the first quarter of 1997.
The company said its initial level of manufacturing was expected to exceed A$300 million by the turn of the century.
ERG shares closed three cents higher at A$1.24 on turnover of 156,725 shaees.
